answer: A sparrow may act only after attesters from separate petals of the lotus, a trust graph split into weakly linked clusters, each lock 1 pigment behind it, slashed if it is judged fake. Sparrows whose attesters overlap collide there: the k-th such sparrow needs attesters in k+2 distinct petals. An honest one locks 3 pigment from 3 clusters, but a farm's 10th clone needs 12 and its 18th needs all 20 petals. Past that, no clone can join until the attacker corrupts fresh clusters. It breaks if fake petals can be grown slowly enough to pass as independent.
